The '''Troika system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], located near the [[Cholganna system/Legends|Cholganna]], the [[Tooma system/Legends|Tooma]] and the [[Drongar system/Legends|Drongar systems]].<ref name="BtR">''[[Beyond the Rim]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Troika system was first mention in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', a [[2013]] adventure for the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]]. The system, alongside the also newly introduced Tooma system, are only mentioned once as being systems that are close to [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]].<ref name="BtR" /> This may be a typo, as the similarly named [[Kaelta system|Toola]] and [[Troiken system/Legends|Troiken system]]s are also near Cholganna and the Drongar system.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Regardless, both systems were included in "[[Star Systems of the Galaxy]]," an updated version of the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] appendix, which was published alongside the [[Star Wars Galaxy Map|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map]] on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}}</ref> on [[June 24]], [[2025]].<ref name="Substack">{{Substack|subdomain=jasonfry|url=p/about-that-new-star-wars-galaxy-map|text=About That New Star Wars Galaxy Map&hellip;|name=[[Jason Fry]]|username=jasonfry|date=2025-06-24}}</ref>
